# Docky 1.0.5
## New features
- Local clipboard shelf for explicitly saved text, web links, images, and hex colours. Copy saved items back to the clipboard, remove individual items, or clear the shelf. - Choose one-hour, 24-hour, seven-day, or manual retention. Expired items are removed while Docky runs or on next launch. Up to 40 items and 30 MB are kept; older items are removed when full. Clipboard content is never polled or uploaded. - Quick actions open from the menu bar or Control–Option–Space. Choose Control–Shift–Space if the default combination is unavailable; registration failures appear in settings. - Start/pause focus, add files, save clipboard content, toggle meeting mode, launch a chosen favourite app, or run a named macOS Shortcut. - Meeting mode pauses keyboard sounds (including previews), automatic hover opening, drag popups, and Docky alerts without changing feature preferences. It ends when disabled or Docky quits. It does not record meetings or silence other applications. - Clipboard and Actions tabs in the island and dedicated settings pages. Icon tabs include accessible labels and tooltips.
## Validation
Debug and universal Release compilation, clipboard classification/expiry/archive round-trip and limits, and existing native shelf/display/interaction checks run before publication. Signing, notarization, and hosted installer verification are performed by publish.sh. Global shortcut conflicts, Shortcuts execution, and the complete clipboard UI still require interactive checks on target Macs. Meeting transcription/notetaking is not part of this release.
